aces-and-eights.desc: Between the gunslingers, the snakes, and the anomalies, there's a good chance you might die in the old west. But there's also a chance you'll find your fortune. Don't matter much. Just put your money on the table and play the hand you're dealt.

ad-astra-per-aspera-hub.desc: Earth is abandoned. The Veil is gone. Humanity is interplanetary. The world is changing and there is only one place left to go: the stars.

aiad-homescreen.desc: Stories about virtual people making a virtual difference.

apotheosis-hub.desc: The discovery of an ancient anomaly upends the balance between the anomalous and the Foundation. As Humanity becomes a race of gods and global order falls, the Foundation and its enemies must decide how much they're willing to sacrifice to achieve their ideals.

bellerverse.desc: Thousands of years after the end of the world, humanity has to deal with the remnants of the SCP Foundation's unfinished work.

black-diamond-billions-hub.desc: Magic and technology ruled by finance, by the company which calls itself Marshall, Carter, and Dark Ltd. Sexily bitchy and beautifully corrupt, watch history meet brutality, money meet untold power, and glamour meet the wallets of the modern supernatural. This is a story of chaos, of the systems which machinate our society, of the twisted opulence upon which billionaires build up their lives and treasure troves. This is a story about British brats, corporate prophecies, family drama, and how wealth stains even the most well-meaning of us all.

broken-masquerade-hub.desc: What was hidden now is seen. How will the Foundation survive in a world where secrecy is no longer an option?

but-a-dream.desc: How much longer until the façade of normalcy cracks? How much longer will you keep them hurting? Quit pretending you've figured us out and just fucking listen to us.

chaos-on-the-monolith-hub.desc: The Eye of the Storm is built upon old ground. Be warned of the vultures circling above, lest the deadlock is torn asunder.

the-coldest-war-hub.desc: As the clash of capitalist and communist spreads, the most covert organization on earth sinks deeper into hiding. But just where will the Foundation go to escape a global war?

competitive-eschatology-hub.desc: The end of the world is here. But it's not just one end of the world. It's all of the ends of the world happening at once, competing with each other, with the Foundation - and humanity - in the middle.

cool-war-2-hub.desc: The FitnessGram Pacer Test is a multistage aerobic capacity test that progressively gets more difficult as it continues. The 20 meter pacer test will begin in 30 seconds. Line up at the start. The running speed starts slowly but gets faster each minute after you hear this signal. bodeboop . A single lap should be completed every time you hear this sound. ding . Remember to run in a straight line and run as long as possible. The second time you fail to complete a lap before the sound, your test is over. The test will begin on the word start. On your mark. Get ready! Start.

daybreak.desc: Daybreak focuses on the state of the world following the solar singularity, and the efforts of those struggling to survive.

doctors-of-the-church-hub.desc: Six hundred years ago, the world ended. Today, only one group protects the secrets of the ancient world until a time when they can be understood again; the priests of the Holy Foundation.

dread-circuses-hub.desc: With Herman Fuller gone, the Freaks are running the Circus now. Flaunting the veil of normalcy and somehow always narrowly avoiding the clutches of the Essie P, Geo Sea and Insurgent Sea, The Circus of the Disquieting provides a sanctuary for anomalous humanoids while offering people a glimpse of what lies behind the Masquerade.

end-of-death-hub.desc: Death is the promise that all of the hardships we face will, at some point, come to an end. But what if death did not keep its promise? If the hardships just kept coming? We would have no choice but to persevere through them. Forever.

eventyr-hub.desc: Every story is a cycle of being heard and retold, reshaped by those who listen and speak. A seed once planted will grow over generations, shaped by those who came after. These ideas might predate us, but the stories are ours and yours.

fading-stars-hub.desc: As time ticks ever onward, the things you long took for granted about the world are vanishing one by one. It's easy to forget what you never consider, but when it's forgotten you feel its absence. When you forget you lose the things that make the world real. When you forget, you can no longer dream.

forgotten-memories-hub.desc: Lives, trapped between the margins, tales just waiting to be told. A world just out of reach, but forever in our minds, SITES beyond reality, trapped in a place of ideas. Beings that are nothing more than a bad memory. Stories of love, intimacy, memetics, ideas and more.

the-alchemy-department-hub.desc: Alchemy. Deeply misunderstood, and often mocked. Alchemy is responsible for more around us than anyone knows. The Foundation Alchemy Department is well aware of this. Their mission is to contain the threats that most of the Foundation don't even believe exist. Threats from the distant past come back to haunt our present.

from-120-s-archives-hub.desc: The world is booming with magic and paratechnology like it never had before, and the planet is more than ready for another shift in the paradigm. History doesn't repeat itself, that much is certain, but it sure as hell rhymes; and from the looks of things, the beginning of the next verse is not that far away…

the-gulf.desc: The Gulf was aflame. This was going to push our little Task Forces to the limit.

memoria-adytum.desc: Before the ages of iron and steel, there once arose a great and deathless Empire. When it fell, the nations of the worlds trembled and breathed a sigh of relief, for the demon of Flesh had finally been conquered.

arbh-class-hub.desc: All it took to destroy the world was one tiny bug and the promise to contain it. They were vastly underestimated. These are the stories - both good and bad - of those part of and affected by that promise.

lampeter-hub.desc: In the dark places – a hidden alley, a door in a train station, a patch of unassuming sky – you can find the back roads to infinity, the lines between realities, a transport network that once spanned half the multiverse – and is now dying a long, slow death.

the-man-who-wasnt-there-hub.desc: The being known as Nobody is akin to a force of nature: his actions are unpredictable and his methods unclear. His purpose and true identity are a mystery to all, including himself. But when they are achieved, he will vanish. This has already happened at least once.

nightfall-hub.desc: Following the Foundation's failed attempt to assassinate the goddess Yvith, the world is plunged into eternal night. Creatures of the night run rampant and higher beings, once incomprehensible, walk among us. This is the tale of Xerophylla and the eternal night of Yvith.

the-ninth-world-hub.desc: A new anomalous age is upon us. Nine books scattered throughout time promise to usher in Paradise. Factions fight in the shadows and across the universe for control of these legendary tomes. In times like this we need unlikely heroes, and an underfunded facility in the midwest might just be what we're looking for.

no-return-hub.desc: No Return is about life after the tipping point of SCP-6500 : Inevitable , along two very different causal paths. One where the Foundation maintains its iron grip on the anomalous world, but those in the know are aware SCP-6500 was the SCPF’s fault and another in which the Foundation dissolves, forming Vanguard – a new organization with various groups of interest – to educate the public about the anomalous world.

on-guard-43-hub.desc: What kind of anomalies does Canada even have? Moose monsters? Sentient leaves? Newfoundland? Oh, we might surprise you. In the true north strange and freezing, myths and memetics and magical muck are just the tip of the iceberg.

our-open-veins-hub.desc: Our Open Veins tells a story where magic and the anomalous are not merely tools to bend reality, but means to achieve liberation. The struggles of oppressed and disenfranchised peoples of Latin America, the implications and consequences of imperialism and capitalism on this region, and how different factions and players react to and use magic for their own ends, are all central to this canon.

pitch-haven-hub.desc: Event Nachash: the first war amongst the gods. We're living in the aftermath. And so are they.

rat-s-nest-hub.desc: Rat's Nest is set in a universe where reality is falling apart due to the absence of LTE 0913, an energy being that had perpetuated our reality up until its destruction.

resurrection.desc: A reconstruction and "resurrection" of the original "central storyline" of the SCP Foundation.

the-s-c-plastics-hub.desc: Sloth's Pit, Wisconsin is a very weird small town with a bottomless pit at it center. Site-87 has been trying, and failing, to make sense of it for decades.

seas-of-orcadia-hub.desc: When the skies burn with crimson flame, Orkney calls. When the tides threaten to wash all out to sea, Orkney Calls. When the earth splits beneath our feet into black abyss, Orkney Calls . When the old ones rise, amidst failing prides, Orkney calls . When the Astral skies leak into the Orcadian night, Orkney calls . When all else fails and the world is at its end, Orkney Calls . I will answer. And my Chains will shatter.

semiotics-hub.desc: Semiotics primarily revolves around the anomalies and personnel of Site-196, chronicling their attempts to both understand otherworldly anomalies beyond perception, meaning, and understanding, as well as prevent their destructive effects on our understanding of reality.

series-0.desc: This is a sequel to a really cool internet thread I found. It was about a moving statue and the men in black.

simulacrum-project-hub.desc: The constant and prolonged influx of anomalies have devastated the Foundation for decades. Their solution? The total migration of humanity into simulated cyberspace.

site-17-hub.desc: People come to power. Other people get hurt. It doesn't matter if it belongs to a conceptual embodiment or a Site Director, power seems to breed injury at Site-17, and people have started to notice. Old structures are groaning beneath the weight of their antiquity, and it's up to a few researchers and SCPs to survive the coming crash.

sotmhub.desc: Mankind reached for the stars only to have the ground pulled out from under them. The United Earth Fleet is on a course for home.

third-law-hub.desc: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic. Any sufficiently advanced magic is reproducible as technology. The street finds its own uses for both.

the-sharkest-timeline.desc: We strike from above so they may writhe in the depths.

those-twisted-pines-hub.desc: Strange things are done in the Northwest Rains. From the extradimensional antics of Three Portlands, to the cybernetic reign of Anderson Robotics, to a bizarre partnership with Wilson's Wildlife Services, it's up to the fine folks of Site-64 to keep everything contained.

unfounded-hub.desc: We've always assumed the SCP Foundation was a necessary evil. But what if it wasn't?

unhuman-hub.desc: The Calamity wiped out all of human life on Earth. Corporations, countries, even the Foundation, gone. And yet, life continues and even thrives. What does humanity mean in a world where humankind is gone?

war-on-all-fronts-hub.desc: SHE WAS BORN TOO POWERFUL, TOO GREAT, TOO WONDROUS. EVEN IN DEATH, HER LEGACY ENDURES.

wonder-world.desc: The world sucks. No, really, it does. But we don't have to suck just because the world sucks. We can make the world a better place. It's cliche, but it's true. And Wondertainment is trying to do just that, one step at a time.

antarctic-exchange-hub.desc: The Antarctic Exchange focuses on the lives and relationships of the researchers from the Third Antarctic Empire during their time at the Foundation.

codename-green-king-hub.desc: Josephine, a powerful reality bender, has been evading the Foundation using a combination of stealth and covert warfare, including memory manipulation on a wide scale. But deep within the Foundation, a small cadre works to capture her… if possible.

lolfoundation-hub-page.desc: We all laughed, but it's not funny anymore.

old-man-in-the-sea-hub.desc: The Old Man in the Sea is a series of stories focusing on a race of space-faring biological arks, and the effects they have on the universe- such as those that one in particular, SCP-169, has on Earth.

on-mount-golgotha-hub.desc: The melody of life sings in the minds and hearts of the multitude. The world goes out not with a bang, nor a whimper, but with a symphony.

only-game-in-town-hub.desc: At the edge of the mind lurks something that prays for the death of definition. It has been on the retreat for some time now, as the world has become a knowable, mapped place, no longer brimming with demons. Watch for it where knowledge lies, seeking to unmake everything known.

project-heimdall.desc: Contingency Planning Operation approved. Codename designation "Project Heimdall". Research potential means by which extraterrestrial intelligence displaying vigorous, active hostility to human life and/or civilization might attempt to conquer, enslave, or exterminate humanity. Analyze likely outcomes. Develop countermeasures and contingency plans. Report findings to O5 Council when complete.

siabhub.desc: Site-17 Director and grown-ass man Benjamin Kondraki has a problem.

the-trashfire.desc: The Old Gods of Daevon lay wounded upon their altars, but their children thrive, eating away at the margins of an already irrational reality. You learn to make do.

seriesEn.t: Unabridged History of Barrow Station Hub

seriesEn.ds: America is a nation at war; at war with itself. This isn't a fault in the system — it is an inherent feature of its design.

ADMONITION is a collab-driven anthology portraying a hubristic and starkly totalitarian SCP Foundation attempting to contain the uncontainable, achieve the unachievable, in the name of their mission and in the spirit of their institutional arrogance.
Fighting with my sister as the world bleeds out.

seriesEn.t: And Every Time We Meet Again
seriesEn.ds: When all it takes is a single spark to raise the restless world ablaze, there's nothing quite as calming to the raging fire as two flame wizards, ready to do whatever it takes to catch the other.
We have hospitals. Doctors. Medicine. All animals have is ANIMAL HOSPITAL .
Pick an item from the Log Of Anomalous Items , and make an interesting tale about it. A random object for you: Tjalla .

The Foundation has a problem. Appliances across the world are coming to life and learning to fight back. Microwaves, toilets, and even your own mobile phone might be watching you right now. It's a problem. And Site-37 has to fix it.

seriesEn.t: The Breach Goes On: Bury the Survivors
seriesEn.ds: On 8 September 2002, all heaven and hell breaks loose at Site-43.

seriesEn.t: The Breach Goes On: Wrong Tomorrow
seriesEn.ds: It's almost enough to make you wonder if totalitarian shadow governments are worth it!

A confrontation between the forces of order and chaos is at hand, and the fate of all possible futures hangs in the balance. However it ends, it's going to be memorable… If there's anyone left to remember it.
The Cack Hard cinematic universe is home to a bunch of dumb stupid stuff, mostly weird crack fiction. Cack fiction, if you will.

Got a poltergeist in your house? See a dead body moving? Is your property suffering from an uncontrolled buildup of mysterious feces? Well, dial 555-605-153-CLEANUP and we’ll be there in a lick of a dime! Once we're done, you can rest easy, because we promise… CLEANLINESS GUARANTEED *
Wow! You just found yourself the Tales of Mr. Collector, a limited edition story collection from Dr. Wondertainment! Read them all and become Mr. Reader!!
Negativity is the enemy of creativity. - David Lynch

A series about dying in Three Portlands, suspected entrapment, journaling, oneirographs, inappropriate times to give campaign speeches, punching your dad, talking to birds, getting revenge, kidnapping ghosts, collecting an inheritance, threatening nuclear war, burglary, betrayal, loss, and attaining resolution.
Stories from the Fae Courts.
Tales from the Horizon Initiative and other things of a theological nature.

This is a Gamers Against Weed story. It's about coming back from the brink, finding comfort in culture and companionship, and fighting back against a harsh world. It's about learning to forgive, and trying to be there for the people who need it most… because whoever and wherever we are, we are not alone.
To those of you who would do harm to humanity, I say this: the Global Occult Coalition stands ready to defend humanity against all foes. Whether it likes it or not.
[g]od is dead. The staff at Site-91 follow a trail leading from its cadaver to a Hellenic cult, an eldritch possession, and the resurgence of the Daeva.

Jerry lost his brother Evan when he was only a child. The world wants him to believe that Evan died in a natural disaster. Jerry knows better. He knows his brother was taken from him, and he will stop at nothing to uncover the truth. This quest will put him in conflict with some of the greatest powers in the anomalous world and force him to question whether he can trust the people closest to him.

Yes, we at Site-322 understand that this is a very stark change of pace for the Foundation. But, if you don't believe that this works, why don't you hear from a few anomalies that were part of the Integration Program?

In Saffron Sands is intended to show, as a series, the anomalous experience in India - a place of economic turmoil, rampant speculation and superstition, and some of the richest mythos on the planet itself.

There are 18 rooms total that make up Kiryu Labs. These and the other rooms are where a few of the Foundation’s caches of anomalous items (not quite interesting enough to merit special containment, not quite harmless enough to be stuffed in a broom closet) are processed.
An anti-fascist series centering around an unlikely group gathering together, and the people they protect.
Project Aims: To successfully create an artificial humanoid through the use of several SCPs, and use it to the benefit of the Foundation.
Greetings! OpusConfidant is the largest SCP Foundation community specializing in competitive analysis and battling. Come and learn!

seriesEn.t: The Phoenix, The Nightingale, and The Magpies
seriesEn.ds: A series about surviving Minnesota, accidental arson, fighting fire with fire, unusual hiring procedures, the pudding secrets of Lake Superior, punching Nazis, angering geese, falling in love, cooking crabs, getting tattooed, disrupting a nuclear power plant, intentional arson, betrayal, loss, and starting over.

To compromise this would mean nothing less than the death of all reality. The lives of too many innocents rely on us to allow this last moral quibble to undermine all that we have done. They must die in the dark, so that we can continue to defend the light.
Battle lines are drawn. Shallow caches are unearthed. Enmities centuries in the making bare envenomed teeth. The world hangs in the balance. Just as planned.

Chosen to head a new Mobile Task Force made up (at least partially) by anomalous individuals by the powers that be, Director Light has a lot of pressure on her. At the same time, an anomaly beneath a Site in Yellowstone has begun to wake up.
Over the past decade, the Foundation has spent copious time and absurd amounts of money bringing back their old tricks. You can't possibly think their enemies haven't been doing that, too?

In a holler between mountains, nested in the belly of Appalachia, a lone Foundation Site lies. Geological Research Site-898. Founded on blood and coal dust, it sits as the central headquarters to the Department of Geology. But there’s far more than just stone out in these woods; between monster and man, the small and isolated Site stands alone under Appalachia’s ancient shadow.

ANTHOLOGY is a 31-day event wherein each day of October, a horror SCP is posted, bound by the theme "ABCs of Death", each by a different author. There's something for everyone here — So long as it is nightmares you seek.

Collected here for your consideration, your introspection, are tales of woe. Tales of madness. Tragedies whose concerns are the foibles of man; they are depictions of his agony. Each file represents a different fear. A unique phobia.

The Tree of Life, introduced to Kabbalah in the Zohar, is a map of Divine creation. It represents the different attributes of God, which confer the divine light of the Ein Sof down into our physical world. Each Sephirah plays a different role in enabling our world to exist, and each emulates a particular attribute of the human soul. This year's horror anthology focuses on the errs of the human soul in reflection of the divine. Ten Sephiroth. Eleven stories. One union.
Five cyborg commando catgirls. One guy in a bathrobe. One spaceship. Space is infinite.
No good deed goes unpunished, no suffering saint is left unseen. In a world hanging off the tightrope, no man of God will go quietly.
